text: Removed ResultContractDescriptor.maxBytes instead of putting an unenforced value on the wire. The descriptor now carries only mode, schema, and declared paths. Also removed the equally inert DeclaredOutputs.maxManifestBytes/factory argument and updated the public example, so no caller-facing contract bound remains without an enforcement point. Structured ResultContract.maxResultBytes remains operative: it becomes DurableResultHandle.maximumResultBytes and is enforced by ResultEnvelopeCodec readers; envelope/output-capture budgets own declared-output bounds. Verified core/test, protocol/test, examples/test, task/test, worker/test, managed/test, ssh/test, and scalafmtCheckAll.
